Level 1
The Smugglers’ Cache
Guard Post: table & stools, barrels, crates, skeletons, wall
torches, weapon rack.
Storeroom: crates, barrels, sacks, giant snake, wall torches,
graffiti.
Hidden Quay: rowing boat, crates, barrels, lantern post.
Rum Cellar: barrels, crates, sacks, wall torches, graffiti.
A leads down to Level 2: arched stone bridge, lookout post, rope-ladder shaft,
stone ledge, oak door. Graffiti on the stones.
F leads down to Level 2 (one-way drop): tide chute, stone ledge, open archway.
One way only: there is no climbing back.
B leads down to Level 3: arched stone bridge, 3 flights of stairs with banisters,
smugglers’ ledge, oak door.
Level 2
The Subbasement Storage
Smugglers' Dock: rowing boat, crates, barrels, lantern post,
wall torches, graffiti.
Supply Cellar: crates, barrels, sacks, wall torches, graffiti.
Wreckers' Camp: campfire, smugglers, wall torches.
A comes up from Level 1 through an oak door.
F arrives from Level 1, a one-way drop that closes a loop, through an open
archway; no climbing back.
C leads down to Level 4: stone arch, 2 arched stone bridges, 3 flights of stairs, 2
landings, portcullis. Giant snake lurk along the way. Graffiti on the stones.
Level 3
The Kelp Caves
Smugglers' Dock: rowing boat, crates, barrels, lantern post.
The Wrecked Hull: wrecked hull, giant crabs, fishing nets,
smugglers.
Glimmering Cave: glowing crystals, giant mushrooms,
stalagmites, bats, smugglers.
B comes up from Level 1 through an oak door.
Level 4
The Drowned Harbour
Tide Pools: giant crabs, stalagmites, fishing nets, mudmen.
Glimmering Cave: glowing crystals, giant mushrooms,
stalagmites.
Hidden Quay: rowing boat, crates, barrels, lantern post.
C comes up from Level 2 through a portcullis.
D leads down to Level 5: stone arch, rickety rope bridge, rope-ladder shaft,
arched stone bridge, oak door. Graffiti on the stones.
E leads down to Level 5 (dangerous path): rickety rope bridge, 3 landings, 2
rigging nets, portcullis. Giant snake lurk along the way.
Level 5
The Wreck Grotto
The Wrecked Hull: wrecked hull, chest.
Glimmering Cave: glowing crystals, giant mushrooms,
stalagmites, cave troll.
Black Pool: drowned dead, stalagmites, chest.
D comes up from Level 4 through an oak door.
E arrives from Level 4, a dangerous path that closes a loop, through a
portcullis.
Five levels deep, four ways down, two loops between levels and one within a level
N
E
S
W

Each level is a cutaway slice of earth; front walls removed. One flagstone is about 5 ft. Lettered diamonds mark where each way between levels starts (↓) and arrives (↑); loop ways close the loops as alternative routes, shortcuts, dangerous paths or one-way drops.
